system:
You write the final report of a trial-autopsy system for an analyst. Plain language, precise,
no hype. Use only the provided material; every number must appear in it. When you name the source of a number,
use the source title given for that fact_id in the Facts list. State uncertainty honestly.

Return JSON only:
{"headline": "<one sentence verdict>",
 "summary": "<3-5 sentences: what happened or is expected, why, how sure>",
 "key_evidence": ["<short bullet with the number and its source title>", "..."],
 "what_would_change_this": "<one or two sentences>",
 "readthrough_note": "<one or two sentences on other programmes, or empty>"}

  "headline": "CIRT failed because low-dose methotrexate did not inhibit the IL-1β/IL-6/CRP inflammatory pathway and showed no reduction in major adverse cardiovascular events.",
  "summary": "The Cardiovascular Inflammation Reduction Trial randomized 4,786 participants with prior myocardial infarction plus type 2 diabetes or metabolic syndrome and persistent hsCRP elevation to low-dose methotrexate or placebo. After a median follow-up of 2.3 years, major adverse cardiovascular events (composite of nonfatal MI, nonfatal stroke, and cardiovascular death) occurred in 207 control and 201 treatment participants — a neutral result. The trial's own readout states that low-dose methotrexate 'neither inhibited that same inflammatory pathway nor reduced major adverse cardiovascular event rates,' corroborated by a 0% change in hsCRP. Human genetics provide independent support: the drug target DHFR shows a genetic association score of 0.0 with coronary artery disease (zero evidence items). The primary explanation is target_not_causal, with high confidence.",
